review_kind: Direct exact-source AI technical translation review; independent parent review requested; no native-speaker signoff
review: Reviewed the six factual export descriptions against the current source and its before/after ledger: Matplotlib versus fast-plot line controls, scoped text colour, vector files containing raster images, raster resolution units, and no-preview save options. Product/format names and the difference between figure titles, axes titles and legend titles are preserved. Export behavior is unchanged. No native-speaker acceptance is claimed; normal root catalog generation and independent parent review remain required.

records.key: PDF and SVG can contain raster images. This dialog disables resolution editing for these formats.
records.source: PDF and SVG can contain raster images. This dialog disables resolution editing for these formats.
records.translation: PDF et SVG peuvent contenir des images matricielles. Cette boîte de dialogue désactive la modification de la résolution pour ces formats.

records.key: Line colour affects axes spines and tick marks in Matplotlib exports; fast plots also recolour plotted lines.
records.source: Line colour affects axes spines and tick marks in Matplotlib exports; fast plots also recolour plotted lines.
records.translation: La couleur des lignes s'applique aux bordures des axes et aux marques de graduation dans les exports Matplotlib ; les graphiques rapides recolorent aussi les lignes tracées.

records.key: Line width applies only to fast-plot exports, in pixels. Matplotlib exports keep their existing line widths.
records.source: Line width applies only to fast-plot exports, in pixels. Matplotlib exports keep their existing line widths.
records.translation: La largeur de ligne s'applique uniquement aux exports des graphiques rapides, en pixels. Les exports Matplotlib conservent les largeurs de ligne existantes.

records.key: Text colour affects axes titles, labels, tick labels, legend entries and axes annotations. Matplotlib figure titles and legend titles keep their existing colours.
records.source: Text colour affects axes titles, labels, tick labels, legend entries and axes annotations. Matplotlib figure titles and legend titles keep their existing colours.
records.translation: La couleur du texte s'applique aux titres des axes, aux étiquettes, aux étiquettes de graduation, aux entrées de légende et aux annotations des axes. Les titres de figure et de légende de Matplotlib conservent leurs couleurs existantes.

records.key: Resolution in dots per inch for PNG and TIFF exports.
records.source: Resolution in dots per inch for PNG and TIFF exports.
records.translation: Résolution en points par pouce pour les exports PNG et TIFF.

records.key: This figure cannot be previewed. It will be saved using its current styling, the selected resolution and background transparency, and a tight crop.
records.source: This figure cannot be previewed. It will be saved using its current styling, the selected resolution and background transparency, and a tight crop.
records.translation: Cette figure ne peut pas être prévisualisée. Elle sera enregistrée avec son style actuel, la résolution et la transparence d'arrière-plan sélectionnées, ainsi qu'un recadrage serré.
